name: muse
specialty: Headless terminal agent for implementation from a prompt file, and advisory second opinions.
notes: Login: muse login (interactive; the harness never runs it). Status: muse --version. Headless: muse exec [--model <id>] [--json] [--prompt-file PATH] [--permission-profile ID] [--workspace PATH] [PROMPT].

API error 402 (Billing verification failed) and API error 429 (Subscription quota exhausted, with a reset time) mean unavailable (billing/quota): drop muse for this run and reassign the seat; never count it as a failed builder or review. Pipe its output to roster.py classify with --exit-code. muse's exit code on these errors is unrecorded (a probe run on 2026-10-22 succeeded), so its recorded forms, `agent loop failed: model failed: API error 402 ...` and `API error 429 ...` at line start, count in the last 20 lines even at exit 0.
A tiny prompt can pass while a long task then hits 429, so classify every dispatch's output, not just the probe.

muse exec --help and muse config show no read-only permission profile (--permission-profile takes an id, and none is defined here), so muse is second-opinion only, never an axis reviewer. Its second-opinion argv still runs --disable-write --disable-shell --disable-web-tools inside --workspace. Revisit if a read-only profile ships.
